axes.concept: Keep the short guided conversation beside a spatial recommendation workspace; enlarge one existing decoration without leaving the chat.
axes.layout: At 1100px and above a 280–340px conversation column sits beside a flexible scene stage; three compact recommendation cards form a preview index below the stage. Narrow layouts stack the conversation, stage and index.
axes.navigation: Preserved horizontal Pictures route navigation. A local preview index selects one scene in place, with current-preview text, aria-pressed and retained focus; each authorized card can open its own decoration as a new workshop project.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans: 24px page title, 20px selected decoration, 18px panel titles, 14–15px working copy and 12–13px metadata; Geist Mono only in the inherited Sempertex wordmark. Counts use tabular figures.
axes.density: The desktop scene is the largest peer object. Compact cards carry preview, full wrapping name and count; the conversation remains at hand. At 840–1099px the preview index becomes horizontal rows; at 640–839px it is three columns; phone cards become single-column horizontal compositions.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton and Animate UI Dialog, plus the inherited native account disclosure and language selector. Custom SVG mock previews and semantic card-preview buttons recompose the product vocabulary.
axes.colour: Pictures globals.css tokens and sibling role mapping without new palette: fondo/superficie, texto/texto-suave, acento/sobre-acento, texto-tenue control edges and error. Decoration drawings are explicitly neutral illustrative mock previews.
axes.motion: Opposed spatial docking: conversation travels -18px, scene stage +26px; preview cards seat from +16px and .6deg with 65ms offsets; the selected scene translates 24px and scales .975 to 1. Expressive 580ms, natural 360ms, subtle 180ms; controls 180/140/100ms. Reduced motion, Quieto and still=1 settle immediately; hidden tabs pause effects.
